title: Paris Family Art & Storybook Journey
summary: A 2-day Paris itinerary for a family with kids (6 and 10) who love Studio Ghibli, art, The Little Prince, and croissants. Highlights include interactive art at Le Musée en Herbe and Impressionist masterpieces at Musée d'Orsay.
tips: Book Musée d'Orsay and Louvre tickets online in advance to skip lines with kids.
Carry a lightweight stroller for the 6-year-old; Paris streets involve cobblestones and metro stairs.
Prayer times are built around Dhuhr, Asr, and Maghrib at Grande Mosquée de Paris (Day 1) and nearby mosques (Day 2); Fajr and Isha are at your hotel.
November weather is cool and damp — pack waterproof layers and warm hats.
